instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Investment platform providing commission-free stock and ETF trading with fractional shares through a mobile app. 150,000 registered users, €600M assets under custody. Recently launched savings plans and pension products. Exploring robo-advisory portfolio construction and ESG scoring integration. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 7 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 25%.

opportunities.title: Automated Core Operational Workflows (Back Office)
opportunities.rationale: The strategic priority is a 15% reduction in operating expenses, pointing directly to high-ROI automation. Focusing on manual processes like order processing and invoicing provides the most immediate impact on efficiency gains using existing resources.

first_actions: Conduct value stream mapping workshops with representatives from Order Processing and Invoicing teams to pinpoint specific pain points and manual handoffs.
Pilot robotic process automation (RPA) tooling on the lowest complexity, highest volume workflow (e.g., basic data entry or status updates).
Establish a cross-functional 'Automation Guild' involving compliance and IT early in discovery phase.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average cycle time for core processes by 20% within 6 months.
milestones: Process mapping completion for three target workflows (Invoicing, Order Processing, Support Ticket Triage).
Successful pilot deployment and validation of RPA on one high-volume task.
Creation of a quantifiable ROI model based on automation savings.

opportunities.title: Formalizing the Innovation Governance Function
opportunities.rationale: While successful pilots demonstrate capability, the organization requires formal structures to scale innovation beyond individual advocates. Defining a clear process for idea intake, prioritization (using quantitative metrics), and resource allocation will stabilize future growth efforts.

first_actions: Draft an 'Idea Funnel' governance document defining stage gates from concept to pilot.
Implement a standardized portfolio management tool or Kanban board accessible by the small leadership team.
Host a mandatory session with all department heads to define departmental KPIs and link them directly to innovation metrics.
execution_plan.success_metric: Average time taken for a vetted idea to transition from concept ideation to resource allocation sign-off is reduced by 50%.
milestones: Board adoption of the Idea Funnel governance process.
Formal nomination of 2-3 process owners responsible for sustaining new operational workflows.

next_steps.action: Conduct a 'Pain Point Inventory' workshop across Finance and Operations to quantify the time, cost, and error rate associated with top 5 manual processes.
Schedule a dedicated meeting with the new CEO to secure formal authority and budget tracking for the Automation Guild, ensuring protected time allocation.
Update internal communications to institutionalize the 'Innovation Advocate' role, shifting it from informal enthusiasm to a formal function reporting through the governance structure.

key_weaknesses: Integration gaps between core systems remain ad-hoc, limiting scalability and increasing technical debt.
Innovation capacity is over-allocated or interrupted by urgent operational incidents, preventing deep focus on long-term strategic projects.
Lack of formalized governance structure means process improvements are dependent on individual advocates rather than institutional mandates.

improvements: Successfully transitioned from a cost-cutting mindset to an efficiency/automation mandate under new leadership.
Validated process improvement capability with the digital customer onboarding flow, achieving 22 points higher NPS and drastically reducing time-to-value.
Increased resources (headcount and budget) provide tangible capacity for structured experimentation.
persistent_gaps: The core challenge remains integrating disparate systems to create seamless, automated end-to-end processes.
The resource dedicated to innovation is still vulnerable to 'production incident fatigue,' requiring structural protection.
Translating successful small pilots into scalable, standardized enterprise processes.
achieved_milestones: Successful deployment of the digital customer onboarding flow (reducing time from 12 days to 5 days).
Securing cross-functional buy-in for process improvement initiatives.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in strategic focus (from general growth to targeted efficiency/automation) and tangible process wins (onboarding flow). The mandate has matured from 'can we build it' to 'how do we automate what we already do well.'
